headline: Wembanyama, Harper lead Spurs past short-handed Mavericks 122-106 for their first victory
description: — Victor Wembanyama had 23 points, seven rebounds and four blocks, Dylan Harper scored 22 points and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Dallas Mavericks 122-106 on Saturday night for their first victory of the season.

headline: 76ers' LeBron James to sit vs. Bucks in first game of back-to-back
description: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.
